- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Televisa's production division operates across several departments: Development, Production, Programming, Casting, Artistic, Music, Special Effects, and Distribution.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Development is responsible for generating ideas and creating scripts for new television shows and series.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Production coordinates all aspects of the production process, including filming, editing, and post-production.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Programming is responsible for scheduling and programming content for Televisa's various channels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Casting auditions and selects actors and actresses for Televisa's productions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Artistic designs sets, costumes, and makeup for productions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Music composes and produces music for Televisa's productions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Special Effects creates visual and special effects that enhance the on-screen experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Distribution sells and distributes Televisa's content to international markets.
